task_instance: Generate a headcount & attrition people-report from a sample HR CSV export (22 employees across Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Executive, with start/end dates and termination types), covering current headcount by department/location/level, trailing-12-month attrition rate (voluntary/involuntary), average tenure, and recommendations.
evidence: Created sample input data at employees.csv (22 employee rows: id, name, department, team, title, level, location, start_date, end_date, manager_id, termination_type). Manually computed all metrics by hand from the CSV rows (no code execution used, per runtime limits): active headcount = 22 total - 3 terminated = 19; verified by summing department breakdown (Engineering 8 + Sales 7 + Marketing 3 + Executive 1 = 19) and location breakdown (Remote-US 10 + NYC 6 + Chicago 3 = 19) and level breakdown (4+5+2+4+1+2+1=19), all three groupings cross-check to the same total. Trailing-12-month terminations identified by end_date within [2025-09-27, 2026-09-27]: 3 records (2 voluntary, 1 involuntary), none of which had an offsetting new hire in the same window (latest start_date in data is 2024-06-01), so beginning headcount = 19+3=22, average headcount = 20.5, giving overall attrition 3/20.5=14.6%, voluntary 2/20.5=9.8%, involuntary 1/20.5=4.9%. Average tenure computed by summing each active employee's (report_date - start_date) in years (sum=139.05 years / 19 employees = 7.3 years). Wrote the full deliverable, following the skill's exact output template (Executive Summary, Key Metrics table, Detailed Analysis with department/location/level/attrition/tenure tables, Recommendations, Methodology with caveats about missing demographic/comp/survey fields), to people_report.md. Verified the deliverable by re-checking that each subgroup table sums to the stated total headcount and that the attrition/tenure arithmetic shown above is internally consistent. This task required no shell/code execution, no binary output, and no connectors -- all data creation, analysis, and report writing were done via plain-text file authoring, which is fully within the office-assistant runtime's granted abilities (read/write/edit text files, no HRIS connector needed since a CSV upload path is explicitly supported by the skill itself).
